steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding items.
Add one line item for the bid sheet.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor portal can access it.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing bid sheet as the vendor.
Submit the negative price and require positive evidence of refusal, including a readable message or disabled submission.
Return to the buyer console to verify no response was recorded.
Confirm that the refused negative bid created no vendor response.
